TITLE: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Internship in Bangalore
COMPANY: Simple Energy
LOCATION: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

We are looking for a highly ambitious, curious and execution-oriented individual to work directly with the founder across AI or technology and EV or automotive initiatives. This is not a conventional internship where you are given repetitive tasks and expected to complete them. You will work on ambiguous, high-impact problems. Where the expectation is to: Understand the objective - research - think - recommend - build - test - improve - implement. You will be expected to use AI aggressively, discover new technologies and tools, build workflows and prototypes, automate repetitive work, analyse opportunities and help the founder move significantly faster. The right candidate will eventually be capable of operating as an AI operations associate, with the potential to grow into a long-term role.
 Selected Intern's Day-to-day Responsibilities Include
 AI, agents & automation:
 Continuously identify opportunities where AI, agents or automation can improve the way the founder or company operates
 Discover and evaluate new AI models, agents, tools and platforms
 Build AI-powered workflows and internal automation
 Experiment with AI coding agents and development tools
 Connect AI systems with APIs, databases and existing tools
 Automate repetitive research, reporting, documentation and operational processes
 Build internal AI assistants and specialised agents
 Test competing AI tools and determine which is most useful for a particular task
 Continuously improve the company's internal AI stack
 Turn AI tools into useful systems rather than merely knowing how to use them
 Build & experiment:
 Identify useful opportunities and create working solutions
 Build internal research agents
 Develop automated market-monitoring systems
 Create competitor intelligence dashboards
 Develop data collection pipelines
 Build founder productivity systems
 Create automated report-generation workflows
 Develop internal knowledge systems
 Build AI-assisted business processes
 Create prototypes for new products or ventures
 Develop small software tools to solve operational problems
 Learn the required technologies to build the solution
 Research & opportunity intelligence:
 Conduct high-quality research on EV and automotive technology
 Research emerging AI technologies
 Explore new business models
 Research startups and technology companies
 Analyse competitor products
 Evaluate new tools and platforms
 Identify emerging market opportunities
 Assess technologies that could create strategic advantages
 Analyse what is happening, why it matters, what we should do and how we could execute it
 Develop the ability to identify opportunities before they become obvious
 Other responsibilities:
 Convert ideas into actionable workstreams
 Break large problems into smaller tasks
 Track projects and commitments
 Coordinate internally with relevant teams
 Follow up on pending actions
 Prepare decision-ready reports
 Prepare presentations and analysis
 Maintain documentation
 Turn discussions and ideas into structured action plans
 Identify bottlenecks and propose solutions
 Reduce the amount of operational and analytical work that reaches the founder
 Internal coordination:
 Coordinate with engineering teams
 Coordinate with product teams
 Coordinate with operations
 Coordinate with manufacturing
 Coordinate with business teams
 Coordinate with other internal stakeholders
 Support internal coordination without making external communication a core responsibility
 Founder productivity & knowledge systems:
 Organise information and research
 Maintain project intelligence
 Create reusable workflows
 Build decision-support systems
 Maintain databases and knowledge repositories
 Automate recurring reporting
 Improve how information moves from research to decision to execution
 What You’ll Gain
 Direct exposure to founder-level decision-making and execution
 Hands-on experience with AI, automation and emerging technologies
 Opportunity to work on real EV, automotive and business problems
 Experience building solutions that create measurable business impact
 Potential opportunity to transition into a founder’s office or AI operations role based on performance
 And most importantly, someone who can turn those thoughts into actual outcomes
 About Company: Simple Energy specializes in the manufacture of smart electric two-wheelers. We are a team of 300+ engineers coming together to make smart, supercharging, and affordable two-wheelers. The company was founded in2019 and is based in Bangalore, India. Our mission is to build the future of mobility that is electric and connected. We at Simple Energy are working towards accelerating this by making them more accessible, affordable, secure and comfortable, and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
